Snapshot: candidate fae77012825f8e1768c75803052476e7784e7247; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 27c4dc6d043994699cc839d6a4e20034fe8c29f2. Opening and closing gates agree; 2246 objects, 2240 accepted remain, 3 new stroke files raw-identical.
Scope: All requested guidance (4 files/all line windows), 3 rubrics, 3 EN/RU kanji lessons, 9 EN/RU context pairs, EN-only 観察 comparison, 7 KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence/header, 36 JMdict entries, 3 KanjiPedia records, all 369 typed pool rows, 9 proposals, 3 adjudications, 3 clarifications, 3 outside-limit records and 4 exact navigation diffs read completely. All commands exited 0; no windows omitted. No web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN within scope: readings, counts, radical, meanings, examples, word forms and bounded visual mnemonics match frozen source and read official evidence. JLPT N3 is the frozen community classification, not a KANJIDIC2 claim.
C2 CLEAN within scope: all 4 edits are standalone navigation wrappers only; links resolve to existing files, missing Russian word pages remain plain text, stroke hashes match, and all 9 directed negatives are supported as introductory comparisons and distinct from active answer meanings in the actual pool. No reverse/transitive inference.
C3 NEEDS FIX: Russian is clear overall, but one confirmed awkward construction in the new 寝 lesson (finding below). Navigation wrappers preserve readability.
N001寒→察 S-intro; cold/weather vs observe/infer, including 察 senses, distinct; roof/middle shape contrast is apt.
N002寒→寝 S-intro; cold/cold season vs sleep/lie down/bedroom; domain co-occurrence is not answer overlap.
N003寒→家 S-intro; cold vs house/home/family and expert suffix; none makes cold a house.
N004寝→寒 S-intro; sleep/lie down/oversleep vs cold; distinct in this direction.
N005寝→察 S-intro; sleeping/bedroom vs observation/inference/police; distinct.
N006寝→字 S-intro; sleep/bedroom vs character/letter/handwriting/village section; roof resemblance is visual, not a meaning claim.
N007察→寒 S-intro; observe/infer/judge/police vs cold/cold season; distinct in this direction.
N008察→寝 S-intro; observation/inference/sympathy vs sleep/lie down; distinct.
N009察→家 S-intro; observe/infer/judge vs house/family and expert/professional; no answer-sense overlap in current title/options.
L001寒 SUPPORTED: facts and weather/touch contrast are bounded; mnemonic is explicitly not history.
L002寝 SUPPORTED: readings and sleep/bed/lie-down distinction are evidenced; mnemonic is explicitly visual.
L003察 SUPPORTED: サツ, さっする, example senses and visual 祭/示 mnemonic are supported and not presented as etymology.
A001 SUPPORTED: cold/weather, joke sense and midwinter clarification stay bounded; no frequency claim.
A002 SUPPORTED: 寝る, 寝坊, 眠る and 睡眠 distinctions reflect the cited entries; no frequency claim.
A003 SUPPORTED: 観察, 察する, 警察 and other cited senses are represented without overclaim; no frequency claim.
NAV01 words/寒い.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 寒 at its existing explanatory mention; CRLF preserved.
NAV02 words/寝る.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 寝 at its existing explanatory mention; CRLF preserved.
NAV03 words/寝坊.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 寝; no other semantic or metadata change.
NAV04 words/警察.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 察; no other semantic or metadata change.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT-ONLY; 冷/冬 share cold/season domain but are not direct options for 寒; O002 LIMIT-ONLY; 夢/休/起/夜 sleep/rest domain observations, no direct 寝 edge; O003 LIMIT-ONLY; 見/知/思/考/判 perception/judgment observations, no direct 察 edge. These are not new quiz guards.
Findings: C3, kanji/寝.md:46 (Примечания), medium, high confidence — 眠る … сосредоточено на самом сне is an awkward, grammatically mismatched Russian formulation for the Japanese verb and may distract from the distinction. Suggested: В 眠る акцент падает на сам сон, тогда как 寝る также означает «лечь; отправиться спать». Evidence: the full RU lesson and 眠る/寝る source senses.
Optional: none.
Limits: Review is limited to the assigned frozen source, current candidate, visible typed pool, bound official records and windows. No tests, validators, builds, Git commands or external pages were used, as instructed; no claim of native-speaker or runtime/device acceptance.
